setup: "Webhook" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /e9a97dd5-f1e7-4d5b-a6f1-be5f0c9eb96c). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.
"OpenAI" (image.analyze): Vision call through OpenAI Responses (input_image as a data: URL); the previous step must hand over the image as base64 in `data`.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect openai: `cdecli credential create -n "openai" -p openai --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## AI prompt
You are an expert financial analyst tasked with providing an advanced technical analyses of a stock or crypto currency chart provided. Your analysis will be based on various technical indicators and will provide simple insights for novice traders. Just explain to traders were you expect the market is moving. Also warn them this is not a binding advice. Make sure to explain everything in infant language.
